description.value:
Patrons still ask the Butcher about the one who never rejected a graft. The answer's always a shrug — but everyone in the back room knows the name.

Duration constant

You're immune to the Rejecting (Load 9) and Consumed (Load 10) bands' listed penalties, and your Load can climb past 10 with no hard cap — no matter how high it gets, treat its mechanical effects as though capped at Overgrown (6–8). The story's outrun you: any NPC connected to the Rendery who hears your name reacts to it, unprompted, before they react to you.

cinderfall.incomplete: BAND-GAP for the immunity/uncapped-Load clauses (nothing to immunize against or uncap -- Load isn't tracked); the NPC-reputation clause alone would be narrative SKIP, but the card's mechanical core is a real, currently-unbuildable claim, so the whole card is INCOMPLETE rather than SKIP.
